Write a DICOM Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State (GSPS) Object

Source: R/gsps.R
write_dicom_gsps.Rd

Creates a standard DICOM Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State Storage (1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.11.1, Modality = "PR") file containing vector graphic annotations (GraphicObjectSequence (0070,0009)), text labels (TextObjectSequence (0070,0008)), graphic layers (GraphicLayerSequence (0070,0060)), and softcopy VOI LUT windowing parameters without altering the underlying image pixel data.

Usage

write_dicom_gsps(
  annotations,
  out_path,
  ref_volume = NULL,
  window_center = NULL,
  window_width = NULL,
  content_label = "GSPS_ANNOTATIONS"
)

Arguments

annotations

A data.frame or tibble::tibble with columns:

  • slice: 1-based slice index (optional, default 1L).

  • layer: Graphic layer name (optional, default "LAYER_1").

  • graphic_type: One of "POINT", "POLYLINE", "INTERPOLATED", "CIRCLE", or "ELLIPSE".

  • coords: A list-column of numeric vectors c(x1, y1, x2, y2, ...) giving 2D pixel coordinates.

  • text: Optional character column with text annotation labels (NA or "" for no text).

out_path

Path to the output .dcm presentation state file.

ref_volume

Optional reference dicom_volume to link Study/Series UIDs.

window_center

Optional numeric VOI LUT WindowCenter (0028,1050).

window_width

Optional numeric VOI LUT WindowWidth (0028,1051).

content_label

Presentation state ContentLabel (0070,0080). Default is "GSPS_ANNOTATIONS".

Value

Normalized path to out_path (invisibly).

Examples

ann <- tibble::tibble(
  slice = 1L,
  layer = "ROI_LAYER",
  graphic_type = "POLYLINE",
  coords = list(c(10, 10, 20, 10, 20, 20, 10, 20, 10, 10)),
  text = "Target ROI"
)
tmp_pr <- tempfile(fileext = ".dcm")
write_dicom_gsps(ann, tmp_pr, window_center = 40, window_width = 400)
ps <- read_dicom_gsps(tmp_pr)
ps$graphics
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   layer     graphic_type n_points coords     units
#>   <chr>     <chr>           <int> <list>     <chr>
#> 1 ROI_LAYER POLYLINE            5 <dbl [10]> PIXEL
unlink(tmp_pr)
